description: This file contains utility functions for managing filesystem operations related to plugin runtimes, such as creating symlinks, copying files, wrapping modules, and staging plugin runtime overlays for a build or deployment process. It orchestrates the setup of plugin runtime directories, handles special file types, and ensures correct linking of node modules.

methods.name: symlinkType
methods.description: Determines the type of symlink based on the operating system ('junction' for Windows, 'dir' for others).

methods.name: relativeSymlinkTarget
methods.description: Computes the relative path from the target directory to the source path, used for creating relative symlinks.

methods.name: ensureSymlink
methods.description: Creates a symlink at the target path pointing to the target value with specified type, recreating it if already exists.

methods.name: symlinkPath
methods.description: Creates a relative symlink from source path to target path.

methods.name: shouldWrapRuntimeJsFile
methods.description: Checks if the source path is a JavaScript file that should be wrapped.

methods.name: shouldCopyRuntimeFile
methods.description: Determines if a file should be copied based on specific filename endings.

methods.name: writeRuntimeModuleWrapper
methods.description: Generates a wrapper module for JavaScript files to re-export content via a normalized specifier.

methods.name: stagePluginRuntimeOverlay
methods.description: Recursively stages plugin runtime overlays by copying, symlinking, or wrapping files from source to target directory.

methods.name: linkPluginNodeModules
methods.description: Creates a symlink for the plugin's node_modules directory within the runtime plugin directory.

methods.name: stageBundledPluginRuntime
methods.description: Main exported function that stages the plugin runtime overlay for a project, setting up necessary directories and links based on the project structure.
